name: Little Tenshi ~Kanata wa Minna no Nukinuki Angel~
original_name: りとる天使 ～カナタはみんなのヌキヌキえんじぇる～
source:
Kanata is everyone's little angel. She came to grant all desires of perverted onii-chans.
But her rival, Enemi-chan, also gets involved...

[edited from the official website]
translation:
彼方是大家的小天使。她来到这里，是为了满足所有变态哥哥们的欲望。但她的对手敌美酱也卷了进来……
